title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1 te Bulevardi Zogu i Pare
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 te Bulevardi Zogu i Pare!
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 prane Ministrise se Drejtesis ne nje pallat te ri me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne nje ambjent qendrimi dhe gatimi se bashku,2 dhoma gjumi , 2 tualete ku njeri eshte me dritare. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug-perendim. Zona ku ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha sherbimet per nje jetese sa me komode.
Apartamenti disponon certifikate pronesie.
Shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Zogu i Pare Boulevard
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Zogu i Pare Boulevard! 2+1+2 apartment for sale near the Ministry of Justice in a new building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in a living and cooking area together, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, one of which has a window. The orientation of the apartment is south-west. The area where the apartment is located offers all services for a comfortable life. The apartment has ownership certificates. Sold furnished as in the photo.
